notes: The taḥwīl ح after مسدد leaves two heads (مسدد, نصر بن علي); the names written once after the last ح (بشر بن المفضل to نبيشة) are the shared tail.
The Companion نبيشة is the last link: Abu al-Malih says that Nubayshah reported the question and answer.
- المعنى - and the wording variants (استحمل للحجيج, على ابن السبيل) are left out.
Khalid's question to Abu Qilaba (كم السائمة قال مائة) is an aside with a different speaker, not stored; flagged for review as a possible second isnad.
